cases.title: Release gate is green
steps: Run `npx tsc --noEmit && npx eslint .`
Run `npm test`
Check `.github/workflows/qa.yml` exists and only references scripts that exist
cases.expected: typecheck and lint clean; `npm test` reports 0 failed; qa.yml runs typecheck, lint and test on push and pull_request

cases.title: SIGINT during setup kills the setup tree and exits 2
steps: Build and make a temp repo as TESTING.md describes
Commit `graph-execution.config.json` with `{"setup":["node -e 'setTimeout(()=>process.exit(0),60000)'"]}`
Start `node $CLI $FIX/diamond --spec $FIX/spec.md --provider fake` in the background
When `ps -ef | grep setTimeout` shows the child, send SIGINT to the CLI
cases.expected: CLI exits 2 within ~3s; output has `to resume: graph-execution --resume` and no 'before initialization'; no setTimeout process remains

cases.title: Hung agent hits the idle timeout and is retried
steps: Temp repo with `{"idleTimeoutMinutes":0.05}` config committed
GRAPH_EXECUTION_FAKE_SCRIPT='{"task:3":{"attempts":[{"hang":true}]}}'
Run the diamond fixture with `--provider fake`
cases.expected: Output says task 3 stopped for producing no output and is retried; run exits 0 with task 3 merged after 2 attempts

cases.title: Orphaned agent reaped after SIGKILL
steps: Temp repo; script `{"task:1":{"attempts":[{"hang":true}]}}`; start the CLI in the background
Wait for the agent pid file in the task-1 worktree, then `kill -9` the CLI pid from the run lock
Set the script to `{}` and run `node $CLI --resume`
cases.expected: Resume reports stopping the leftover agent; that pid is no longer alive; run exits 0 with all tasks merged

cases.title: Failed apply exits nonzero; resuming a finished run refuses
steps: Temp repo; `echo mine > 2.txt` (untracked)
Run the diamond fixture with `--provider fake`; record exit code
`rm 2.txt`; `node $CLI --resume` (exit 0)
Run `node $CLI --resume` again
cases.expected: First run exits 2 with 'Not applied to main'; first resume exits 0 and applies; second resume exits 2 with 'already finished' and changes nothing

cases.title: No git identity fails fast
steps: Temp repo with one commit
Run the CLI with `env -u GIT_AUTHOR_NAME -u GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL -u GIT_COMMITTER_NAME -u GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL -u EMAIL HOME=$(mktemp -d) GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1`
cases.expected: Exit 2 immediately with a message to set git user.name/user.email; no `graph-task/*` branches or worktrees created

cases.title: Leftover task worktree refused with cleanup steps
steps: Temp repo; `git worktree add -b graph-task/20260101-000000-abcd/2 <outside dir>`
Run with `GRAPH_EXECUTION_RUN_ID=20260101-000000-abcd`
Run the printed cleanup commands and run again
cases.expected: First run exits 2 at startup printing the worktree path and cleanup commands, no task starts; after cleanup the run exits 0

cases.title: Suite log stream resumes from client offsets
steps: Start a demo suite with `--web` and a hanging task
Append `gap\n` to that task's log, then request `/api/logs/stream?...&offsets=<size before append>`
cases.expected: An `event: log` with that offset and text `gap\n` arrives without further writes

cases.title: Quoted provider args stay single words
steps: Run `npx vitest run src/providers`
With a stub provider, set `GRAPH_EXECUTION_CLAUDE_ARGS='--x "oops'` and start a run
cases.expected: Recorded argv keeps `"two words"` and `a\ b` as single args; the unterminated quote fails at startup with exit 2 naming the env var

cases.title: Run lock is not reentrant
steps: Run `npx vitest run src/state/state.test.ts`
cases.expected: Second acquisition in-process rejects with LockError; first release does not delete a later holder's lock
